items.title: Classrooms
items.description: Well-lit, quiet classrooms arranged for small batches so every student stays within reach of the teacher.

items.title: Campus
items.description: A compact, secure campus in Ram Nagar with dedicated study space, library access and staff rooms open to students.

items.title: Academic Activities
items.description: Daily practice sessions, weekly tests, revision cycles and structured doubt-clearing built into the timetable.

items.title: Student Activities
items.description: Commerce club discussions, quizzes, group presentations and peer study circles that build confidence.

items.title: Workshops
items.description: Skill workshops on accountancy practice, aptitude, legal reasoning and examination technique.

items.title: Seminars & Events
items.description: Career seminars, parent interactions and college days that connect academics with real professional pathways.
